rationale: ArcLight's current investments page lists Pike Holdings as a current investment. The November 2021 SEC contribution agreement expressly defines Pike Petroleum Holdings, LLC as "Pike Holdings" and places it in the sponsor holding chain above PPH Management Holdings, LLC, TLP Acquisition Holdings, LLC, TLP Finance Holdings, LLC, TransMontaigne Partners LLC and TransMontaigne Operating Company L.P. Pike Holdings is therefore an intermediate sponsor shell, not the operating company. The single appropriate manager-level PortCo is TransMontaigne Partners LLC, the U.S. bulk-liquids terminaling, storage and transportation platform. Current direct evidence shows that TLP Finance Holdings, LLC owns 100% of TransMontaigne Partners LLC and is an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of ArcLight Energy Partners Fund VI, L.P. ArcLight first acquired platform control through the general partner on 2016-02-01; full platform ownership followed the take-private closing on 2019-02-26. The 100% platform stake must not be applied to Pike Petroleum Holdings, LLC, whose current economic capitalization is NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED. Pike Corporation and Pike County Light & Power are unrelated entities and must remain untouched.

acquisitionExitCheck.initialControlAcquisition: CLOSED 2016-02-01. NGL Energy Partners sold its interest in TransMontaigne GP L.L.C. to Gulf TLP Holdings, LLC, an ArcLight Capital Partners affiliate, for $350 million. The acquired general partner held the partnership's 2% general-partner interest and incentive distribution rights. NGL retained approximately 3.2 million common units and its separate TransMontaigne marketing business, so this was a control acquisition, not 100% ownership of the operating platform.
acquisitionExitCheck.takePrivateOrFullOwnership: DEFINITIVE AGREEMENT DATED 2018-11-25; ANNOUNCED 2018-11-26; CLOSED 2019-02-26. TLP Finance Holdings, LLC, an indirect subsidiary of ArcLight Energy Partners Fund VI, L.P., agreed to acquire all outstanding common units not already held by ArcLight affiliates for $41.00 per unit, approximately $536 million in aggregate. At closing, TransMontaigne became wholly owned by an ArcLight affiliate, converted from TransMontaigne Partners L.P. to TransMontaigne Partners LLC, and TLP Finance became its sole managing member.
acquisitionExitCheck.subsequentExitSearch: No platform-level sale, exit, merger, dissolution, rename or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through 2026-08-15 in the opened ArcLight, TransMontaigne, SEC and company-release sources. ArcLight still lists Pike Holdings as Current; the latest annual filing states that TLP Finance owns 100% of TransMontaigne Partners LLC; the September 2025 company filing ties TLP Finance to ArcLight Energy Partners Fund VI, L.P.; and TransMontaigne announced a first-quarter 2026 debt-holder earnings call in June 2026. The 2026 cessation of voluntary SEC periodic reporting was not an ownership transaction. Fisher Island, Fairfax and Charlotte transactions were asset-level dispositions or sale agreements beneath TransMontaigne and do not establish a platform exit. Public direct-source closing confirmation for the Fairfax and Charlotte asset sales is NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED.
